name: High-band pan-LFO pad width without low-end phase smear
goal: Widen a narrow analog-style pad without chorus/imager phase damage in lows/mids: multiband-pan only the high band with a slow or 16th-note L/R swirl (sine or subdued profile), keep lows mono-stable, and pull mix/amount down if motion is too pronounced.

source.title: How to widen pads without causing phase issues

prerequisites: Multiband pan or band-split + auto-pan; pad that sounds good but narrow

inputs.name: band
inputs.description: Affect high band only (leave lows/mids un-panned)

inputs.name: lfo_rate
inputs.description: e.g. bar (4/4 slow swirl) or 16th notes

outputs.name: wide_pad_highband_motion
outputs.description: Pad with high-band pan motion width

steps.action: Start from a good but narrow pad. Avoid broadband chorus/imager wideners that commonly cause phase issues in low end and midrange.
steps.expect: Pad tone kept; need width only

steps.action: Insert multiband pan / band-limited auto-pan. Solo or target the high band only so lows stay centered.
steps.expect: Only highs are eligible to move L/R

steps.action: Draw a sine (or subdued sine) pan path so highs slowly swirl L↔R. Try bar-length (4/4) for gentle immersion or 16th-note rate for more motion.
If 16ths feel too pronounced: switch to a less extreme pan profile and/or lower overall mix/amount of the pan effect.
A/B before/after in context: pad should envelop more without the washy phase of chorus/imager on full-band signal.

verification: Only high band is auto-panned; lows remain centered
No full-band chorus/imager on the pad for this width
Mix/amount not so high that motion distracts
constraints: Ground every step in the source YouTube-provided Show-transcript text; do not invent UI paths or numeric settings not stated there.

Original synthesis / signal-flow only — map brand UI (Ableton/Vital/Serum/VAST/etc.) to portable osc/filter/env/LFO/FX modules for Traveler-inspired or Web Audio hybrid; never rip presets, wavetables, or samples.
Prefer transferable parameter relationships over vendor-specific preset or bank names.
Not affiliated with plugin/synth vendors named in the source video.
Delta vs odd/even unison and chord-split stereo skills: this widths via high-band pan modulation, not voice count or MIDI note splits.
Prefer this over broadband chorus/imagers when the complaint is phase smear in low/mid.
